question: What Is the Difference Between Single Stage and Multi Stage Compressor?
body_html:
A single stage compressor compresses gas from suction to final pressure in one cylinder, while a multi stage compressor uses two or more cylinders in series with intercooling between stages.

FeatureSingle stageMulti stage
CylindersOneTwo or more in series
IntercoolingNoneBetween every stage
PressureModerate, about 150 psiHigher, safely
Work per unit gasHigherLower

Ideal per stage ratio: (P_final ÷ P_suction)^(1/n), so 1 to 16 bar abs in 2 stages gives 4.
